changes: {'phase': 'Phase 1: Waxing', 'description': "Begins as the 'new moon' (ሠርቀ). Light first appears on it, starting with a 'half of a seventh part' and increasing over 14 days as it receives light from the sun."}
{'phase': 'Phase 2: Full', 'description': "On the 14th or 15th day, its light is 'completed'. It shines the entire night, rising in the east as the sun sets in the west."}
{'phase': 'Phase 3: Waning', 'description': "Its light decreases daily over 15 days until it is all gone. Its orbit is described as 'empty, without light' at the end of this phase."}
